# Repository instructions

Read and apply `/AGENTS.md` (canonical project rules). Before making a domain-specific change, consult `docs/agent/README.md` and the corresponding `.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md`, plus relevant `docs/architecture/` pages.

The Vercel + Neon stack is **planned**, not yet implemented on `development`; do not mistake current `localStorage` and client-computed gameplay for approved future architecture. When in doubt, distinguish implemented behavior from planned behavior and review the linked GitHub issues.
